help.title: AgentCore tips
help.shortcut.contextInject: Global context injection (select any Unity object then press this to auto-capture context into chat)
help.shortcut.newline: New line in the input box
help.tip.hierarchy: Select an object in Hierarchy / Project / Console then press Ctrl+Shift+X — the Agent will understand the context automatically
help.tip.anyPanel: Press Ctrl+Shift+X over any unfamiliar Unity panel element to auto-capture the window info
help.tip.autoCompress: In multi-turn conversations the Agent auto-compresses old messages, no need to clean up manually
help.trust.lowMed: Trust Low/Med — this session lets ReadOnly/Low/Medium risk tools through, High/destructive still prompt
help.trust.yolo: YOLO (All) — this session lets ALL tools through, including delete / push / compile / other destructive ops. Use with care.
silentMode.tooltip: Silent mode: freeze chat UI during agent execution to avoid interfering with performance measurements. Results appear all at once when the task finishes.
silentMode.tooltip.silent: Silent mode ON — chat UI is frozen. Click to switch back to Batched (live) mode.
silentMode.tooltip.batched: Batched (default) — chat UI updates live. Click to enable Silent mode (freeze UI, cleaner performance profiling).
